trajectory_type: recorded LuSNAR simulated rover-body planar trajectory
display_source: Each scene manifest.json direct.metric_actions in meters; prepend anchor [0, 0].
projection: x = -left, y = -forward; center the bounding box and apply one common pixels-per-meter scale to both axes. No smoothing or synthetic controls.
video_mapping: 16 video frames at 4 FPS; frame index floor(mediaTime * 4) corresponds to trajectory point index frame + 1. Origin is the last observed context pose, not an encoded prediction frame.
timing: Playback uses encoded frame order, not the irregular original capture intervals. Original timestamps and offsets remain in each manifest.
coordinate_limitations: Rover body XY after the documented world-Y reflection and anchor-yaw rotation; not a calibrated optical-camera trajectory. Height, roll, and pitch are omitted.
